description.value: The Sticky Wicket bills itself as Vancouver Island's biggest pub, occupying multiple distinct rooms — including a cricket-themed main floor, a rooftop patio, a games room with pool and darts, and a large live music venue — all within the historic Strathcona Hotel complex in the heart of downtown Victoria. Operating since 1913, it offers a full food menu including a kids menu and late-night options alongside an active calendar of live music and special events. A touring cyclist rolling into downtown Victoria would find this a substantial refuelling stop with plenty of seating options.

bike_parking_detail: 3 racks within 100m: rack at 34m; rack at 63m; rack at 77m.
